Why the Quran is from God

It corrects its own prophet

The Quran, recited by him, reviews his own conduct in public, and it is recited to this day.

He turned to the powerful and away from a blind man who came seeking: so many commentators read the opening of sura 80. Another verse begins with pardon, then asks why he gave a certain leave. Another says he hid something within himself, fearing people, when God has more right to be feared. He recited these words himself, and they were kept. Weigh what kind of author leaves them in.

﴿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ١ أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ٢ وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ٣ أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ٤ أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ٥﴾

Translation of the meaning

He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting]. But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him? As for he who thinks himself without need,

Quran · Abasa 80:1-5

﴿فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ٦ وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ٧ وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ٨ وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ٩ فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ١٠﴾

Translation of the meaning

To him you give attention. And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified. But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge] While he fears [Allāh], From him you are distracted.

Quran · Abasa 80:6-10

﴿عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنكَ لِمَ أَذِنتَ لَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يَتَبَيَّنَ لَكَ ٱلَّذِينَ صَدَقُوا۟ وَتَعْلَمَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Allāh has pardoned you, [O Muḥammad, but] why did you give them permission [to remain behind]? [You should not have] until it was evident to you who were truthful and you knew [who were] the liars.

Quran · At-Tawbah 9:43

﴿وَإِذْ تَقُولُ لِلَّذِىٓ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَمْسِكْ عَلَيْكَ زَوْجَكَ وَٱتَّقِ ٱللَّهَ وَتُخْفِى فِى نَفْسِكَ مَا ٱللَّهُ مُبْدِيهِ وَتَخْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ وَٱللَّهُ أَحَقُّ أَن تَخْشَىٰهُ ۖ فَلَمَّا قَضَىٰ زَيْدٌ مِّنْهَا وَطَرًا زَوَّجْنَـٰكَهَا لِكَىْ لَا يَكُونَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ حَرَجٌ فِىٓ أَزْوَٰجِ أَدْعِيَآئِهِمْ إِذَا قَضَوْا۟ مِنْهُنَّ وَطَرًا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ مَفْعُولًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

And [remember, O Muḥammad], when you said to the one on whom Allāh bestowed favor and you bestowed favor, "Keep your wife and fear Allāh," while you concealed within yourself that which Allāh is to disclose. And you feared the people, while Allāh has more right that you fear Him. So when Zayd had no longer any need for her, We married her to you in order that there not be upon the believers any discomfort [i.e., guilt] concerning the wives of their claimed [i.e., adopted] sons when they no longer have need of them. And ever is the command [i.e., decree] of Allāh accomplished.

Quran · Al-Ahzab 33:37

You might ask

QuestionCouldn't this be a clever device?
AnswerSome critics say so: self-correction builds trust. Yet would a man seeking standing leave these scenes for followers to recite forever? This app calls it a sign, not a proof alone.Quran · At-Tawbah 9:43
QuestionBut didn't 33:37 end in his own marriage?
AnswerIt did, and critics point to that. The verse gives its reason: a rule for all believers on adopted sons' former wives. It also records his fear of what people would say.Quran · Al-Ahzab 33:37
QuestionWhy would God correct a Prophet at all?
AnswerBecause a prophet is human, and the Book says so plainly. Seeing him corrected keeps worship for God alone and keeps people from raising him above what he was.Quran · Al-Kahf 18:110

He carried to the world the very words that corrected him.
